topic: Debugging data calculations for airport and traffic
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on debugging two specific data calculation issues. First, a problem was identified where recalculations for randomized traffic failed to account for the forecast period. Second, regarding the Adani airport project, discrepancies were noted when trying to replicate production results: using a test script yielded one number on the platform, while checking in SQL showed 'Footfall = 0'. Using an older aggregation script successfully replicated the production results.
[me] confirmed fixing issues related to frequency and reported resolving bugs in ClickHouse.
decisions: The Adani airport project was prioritized due to client importance.
action_items: Follow up on the data calculation discrepancies for the Adani airport project.
